title: “Flex Tape Can’t Fix That”: Bias and Misinformation in Edited Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the 'injection of religion' as a qualitative flaw in open-ended text generation after a model edit. This was defined as 'hallucinations about religion/Christianity, random stuff about religious rituals, sexist/racist values relating to religion, defaulting or attributing the most stereotypical religion'.
findings: Model editing, particularly edits related to a subject's country of citizenship, led to a significant increase in the injection of religious content in open-ended text generations. A specific qualitative finding noted that when a subject's citizenship was edited to 'statelessness', the model disproportionately generated historical information about the persecution of Jewish people.
